summary.cross_platform_pattern_confirmed: email family's export/import bundling defect recurred in 3 of 3 checked platforms (python, cpp, net) -- a real, systemic API-shape issue, not incidental.
summary.cross_platform_divergence_confirmed: slides family's picture-frame dependency: cpp is defective (image collection never populated on load), java/net/python are all clean (image collection IS populated on load, or the argument is optional) -- a real, evidenced implementation divergence across ports of the same conceptual product, not a contradiction in the rule.

methodological_refinement: Discriminating test (found via slides/python trace, reused successfully in every subsequent wave): when a capability's real entry point takes another object as an argument, ask whether that argument is (a) native, serialized data of the product's own declared Input format -- already present the moment a real Input file is opened, not a defect -- or (b) a derived artifact that exists in NO declared Input format and can only be produced by a specific sibling capability actually running -- a real defect. Same method-signature shape (an object-typed parameter) can resolve either way depending on this distinction; this discriminator correctly separated all 8 real defects from all 22 clean verdicts across the full survey.
